purpose: Replicate the frozen stable-register semantic transducer's causal transfer to a six-input five-step program geometry after the calibrated path ensemble failed its selector-specific lesion bar.
claim_boundary: fresh bounded natural-language semantic-program transfer across the previously unseen six-input five-step branch-weave geometry by one frozen model-bound transducer; no selector gain, open-domain reasoning, frontier performance, or serving authority

discovery_evidence.calibrated_selector_failure: Only one answer-exact win separated calibrated selection from the necessary-condition selector lesion; one-sided exact p=0.5.
discovery_evidence.causal_canary_selection: lowest four construction-id SHA-256 values per topology

controls.coefficient_lesion: Zero every learned feature-dependent coefficient while preserving biases, decoder topology, inputs, and compute path.
controls.hidden_token_shuffle: Deterministically permute the captured resident hidden rows across source-token positions while preserving every vector and decoder coefficient.
controls.ordinary_resident_27b_decode: Decode the exact same natural-language tasks directly from the descriptor-bound fused 27B only after the neural mechanism bar passes.

criteria: all 48 preregistered examples are evaluated in every neural arm
the frozen transducer emits at least 18 exact answers
the frozen transducer exceeds coefficient_lesion with paired one-sided exact p < 0.05
the frozen transducer exceeds hidden_token_shuffle with paired one-sided exact p < 0.05
every paired treatment-only win executes from an IR causally bound to the frozen transducer receipt
no target labels, expected answers, domain identity, or source text are available to the transducer
the feature cohort has zero source-text overlap with training and discovery cohorts
the frozen transducer exceeds ordinary resident 27B decode with paired one-sided exact p < 0.05
ordinary resident 27B has the same task texts and no smaller public answer budget
all exact ordinary answers remain available to a non-regressing runtime composition policy
